findings.impact: A helper descendant can remain live after timeout TERM cleanup claims success; a normal wrapper exit with closed-pipe descendant is accepted by command_ok while the descendant is still running. Finite whole-owned-tree control is not established.
findings.minimal_remedy: Keep ownership identity long enough to terminate/reap or otherwise establish bounded empty owned tree after leader exit, including normal exit, closed pipes and noncooperative descendants. Do not infer group emptiness from communicate/reaping the direct child. Avoid PID/PGID reuse and unrelated-group signalling; preserve original command error and all byte evidence.
findings.title: Direct wrapper exit is mistaken for complete owned process-group cleanup

findings.impact: After start pair selection, changed current published identity, stale capacity observation, or actual HARD_RESERVE is read by snapshot but ignored. Exact source evaluator rejects each changed publication, yet actual candidate warm/start prefix emits owner-start-commit with no failure.
findings.minimal_remedy: At each eligibility/commit guard compare the live publication to the selected exact-source/strict pair. Before start, publication advancement may use a fresh bounded exact pair within original limits; after start publication/commit, mismatch must prevent accepted eligibility. Do not place full live publication into the earlier static same_guard because normal heartbeat changes are legitimate. No second heavy Catalog scan or higher warm bound is required.
findings.title: T0 freshness checks read newly bad live state but continue using the cached good pair

findings.impact: Whole-prefix fixtures accept installed_dependencies exact_match=false/editable=true/count0, a boolean record_verified_files=True, and command after.utc earlier than before.utc. This violates the claimed malformed/forged-proof rejection, although an honest unchanged canonical verifier normally does not emit these contradictions.
findings.minimal_remedy: Validate exact required static proof fields/types and positive nonboolean counts, coherent complete command before/after clock ordering and bounded cross-clock interval, and matching provenance/budget references. Retain rejected originals; no new installed forest/Catalog scan is needed.
findings.title: Contradictory earlier static proof and command-clock receipts satisfy the proof validator
findings.trust_boundary_limit: This is structural receipt validation under explicit root-custody fixtures, not a claim that arbitrary malicious root can be defeated or that genuine installed package corruption was observed.

not_counted_as_separate_findings: Arbitrary malicious-root resistance is outside this control trust boundary.
No untested callback-omission claim or Linux process-tree qualification is granted.
